title: pendingReward view does not clamp against balance and does not project dispatcher mintDebt

classification.assetImpact: View-only. Frontends/keepers may display an inflated pending figure, then issue claim transactions that revert under story-002 _safePay revert semantics. Wasted gas; confusing UX. No funds at risk.
attackPath: 1. Pool in shortfall state (contract balance < entitlement).
2. Frontend/keeper reads pendingReward(user); view returns full entitlement without balance clamp.
3. Frontend triggers claim(); _safePay reverts; gas wasted.
4. Separately, view does not project dispatcherHook.mintDebt() into acc so it can under-report during accrual between syncs.
classification.likelihood: moderate during shortfall; impact is observability/UX only.
classification.assumptions: Frontend/keeper calls pendingReward and then claim.
classification.externalRequirements: Transient shortfall state on the contract.

justification: Low/QA. View-function inaccuracy that affects integrator UX but not on-chain value. C4 caps 'unused view function issues' at QA/Low; this view is used externally (frontends/keepers) so strict 'unused' cap does not apply, but the magnitude of harm (wasted gas, inaccurate UI) is below the Medium threshold. QA-tier defensive improvement.
